title: &aAffixes and Arcana
subtitle: Apotheosis: rarity, gems, reforging, world tiers, enchanting and spawners.

quests.title: Loot With a Pedigree
desc: &eApotheosis&r gives gear a &erarity&r (&fCommon&r, &aUncommon&r, &9Rare&r, &5Epic&r, &6Mythic&r) and random &eaffixes&r: bonus damage, life steal, crit, sockets, special effects on hit.
Read the &eChronicle of Shadows&r, Apotheosis's own guide: craft a book with a gold ingot. It explains every system in this chapter.

quests.title: World Tier: Ascent
desc: You reached Frontier in Act I. World tiers go &eHaven > Frontier > Ascent > Summit > Pinnacle&r: each makes monsters stronger and loot better, and from Frontier on, &cApothic Invaders&r (armed boss mobs) roam.
Open the tier screen with its key (search 'World Tier' in Controls) to see what unlocks the next tier, then activate it. Each player chooses their own tier.

quests.title: World Tier: Summit
desc: Summit asks for the Wither's death, among other things. Monsters here hit hard; your gear should have Rare or better affixes and socketed gems.
Lantern ring trials sit around this tier.

quests.title: World Tier: Pinnacle
desc: The top of the mountain. Mythic gear, perfect gems and the hardest monsters in the pack.
This is the tier the final fight is meant for.

quests.title: Salvage, Don't Toss
desc: Affixed gear you don't want goes into the &eSalvaging Table&r. It breaks items down into rarity materials (Mysterious Scrap Metal, Luminous Crystal Shards and rarer ones).
Those materials pay for reforging, so salvage everything you won't use.

quests.title: Reforging
desc: The &eSimple Reforging Table&r rerolls an item's affixes, paid for with &eSigils of Rebirth&r and rarity materials. It offers you three results; pick the one you like.
It handles the lower rarities. Good for turning a decent sword into a great one.

quests.title: The Reforging Table
desc: The full &eReforging Table&r works on every rarity, up to Mythic. Higher rarities cost rarer materials.
Reforge the weapon you plan to keep through the late game.

quests.title: Augmenting
desc: The &eAugmenting Table&r changes one affix instead of the whole item: upgrade it or reroll just that line, using Sigils of Enhancement.
This is how you perfect an item without losing what you already like about it.

quests.title: Gems and Sockets
desc: &eGems&r drop from monsters and chests. Put one into an item with an empty &esocket&r at a &eSmithing Table&r; each gem gives different bonuses on weapons, armour or tools.
A &eSigil of Socketing&r adds a socket; a &eSigil of Withdrawal&r takes gems back out. Socket a gem now.

quests.title: Cutting Gems
desc: Gems come in purities: &7Cracked&r, Chipped, Flawed, Normal, Flawless, &6Perfect&r. Higher purity, bigger bonus.
The &eGem Cutting Table&r uses gem dust and rarity materials to raise a gem's purity. Higher world tiers drop purer gems.

quests.title: Three Stats
quests.subtitle: Apothic Enchanting
desc: The enchanting table has three stats. &aEterna&r sets the highest level you can reach, &cQuanta&r adds randomness (stronger and weaker rolls), and &5Arcana&r gives more and rarer enchantments.
Bookshelves raise them; hover the table's stats to read them. Enchant an item at &elevel 30&r.

quests.title: Shelves of Fire
desc: Special shelves push the stats much further than wood. The &eHellshelf&r comes from the Nether.
Mix shelves: each kind adds different amounts of Eterna, Quanta and Arcana. JEI (press &eU&r on a shelf) shows them.

quests.title: Shelves of the Sea
desc: The &eSeashelf&r is built from ocean materials. Some shelves can be &einfused&r on the enchanting table itself into stronger versions.
Combine Hellshelves and Seashelves to balance your table.

quests.title: A Balanced Table
desc: Enchant an item while your table has at least &e10 of each stat&r.
A balanced table gives strong, varied enchantments instead of one lucky roll.

quests.title: The Enchantment Library
desc: Feed enchanted books into an &eEnchantment Library&r. It stores the enchantments, and you can pull out a book of any of them at any level up to the highest you put in.
One library for the whole party saves a lot of books.

quests.title: Shelves of the End
desc: &eEndshelves&r need Infused Dragon's Breath, so they come after the Ender Dragon. They're the strongest shelves, and can be upgraded into Draconic Endshelves.
Deep-dark &eDeepshelves&r are worth building too.

quests.title: Level One Hundred
desc: Enchant an item at &elevel 100&r. Vanilla stops at 30; Apothic Enchanting lets enchantments go far past their normal maximum.
This is what Pinnacle gear is made of.

quests.title: Take the Spawner
quests.subtitle: Apothic Spawners
desc: Break a monster spawner with a &eSilk Touch&r pickaxe and it drops as an item you can place anywhere.
A dungeon spawner near your base becomes a mob farm.

quests.title: Rewire the Spawner
desc: Right-click a placed spawner with a &espawner modifier&r to change it: spawn more mobs, spawn faster, ignore light, need no player nearby, obey redstone.
JEI lists every modifier and what it does (search 'spawner').

quests.title: The Ultimate Spawner
desc: Build a spawner with the shortest delays, redstone control, no mob AI, no spawn conditions and no need for players.
An endless supply of drops, on a switch. Put it in a claimed chunk.
